content.heading: Remedies for enforcement of rights conferred by Part III
content.text: The right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of the rights conferred by Part III is guaranteed. The Supreme Court shall have power to issue directions, orders or writs, including writs in the nature of habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari, whichever may be appropriate. The right guaranteed by Article 32 shall not be suspended except as otherwise provided for by the Constitution. Canonical: provision:india:constitution-art-32.
